scope: Task B: the four higher firearm feat roots (Greater Weapon Focus, Weapon Specialization, Greater Weapon Specialization, Improved Critical) across Pistol/Musket/Blunderbuss — 12 root/weapon combinations — committed through real LevelUpController levels, real feat slots, the native parent-to-parameter child-selection flow and native prerequisite checks on a disposable unit. No production prerequisite was changed; no target fact was inserted directly; the disposable unit's real firearm proficiency uses the same real feature grant as the qualified dependent-feats scenario.
presentation: data-level FeatureUIData monogram verification via the patched FeatureUIData(BlueprintFeature, FeatureParam) constructor (null Icon + exact P/M/B acronym) for every committed fact; native in-game level-up SCREEN navigation is separately evidenced by the previously qualified creator/level-up captures for Weapon Focus/Rapid Reload and remains a supervised-checklist item for the higher roots' Total/sheet screens (see the review packet)

coverage.ladder: Fighter 1-19 through real StartWithoutAssigningStaticInstance/SelectClass/ApplyClassMechanics/SelectFeature/ApplyLevelup/Cancel cycles; real proficiency fact; per-level feat-slot states
coverage.weaponFocusPrerequisiteChain: Weapon Focus committed per kind (Pistol/Musket/Blunderbuss) first via the same slots; GWF correctly refused at fighter 2-7 (ineligible control), committed at 8+
coverage.selectionRoute: bare-root item then native child parameter state; every appended entry's FeatureParam is the registered Weapon Focus choice of the kind (shared published parameter set)
coverage.cancellation: a Greater Weapon Specialization selection followed by controller Cancel without ApplyLevelup committed nothing
coverage.monogram: FeatureUIData for all 12 committed facts: null Icon + exact P/M/B letter

runs.note: final-artifact confirmation run on the byte-identical package after all documentation stabilized

knownLimits: Screen-level rendering of the higher-root entries in the actual level-up/Total UI at the moment of selection is not captured here; controller/selector checks and screen checks are deliberately separate (mission section 4). The previously qualified native Total/sheet monogram machinery covers the shared presentation path.

Committed-fact parameters use the Weapon Focus choice blueprint of the kind for all five integrated roots, which is the design's shared published parameter set; the KMG per-root wrapper features (KMG_GreaterWeaponFocus_* etc.) remain the menu/identity wrappers, not the committed param.
